spans.s:
√kṣad 'divide'
present: [1.] kṣádate etc. 
perfect: cakṣadé etc. 
derivatives: kṣattṛ́ -kṣad RV. kṣádman RV.

√kṣan 'wound'
present: [8.] kṣaṇóti kṣaṇuté etc. B.+ 
[perfect: cakṣāṇa cakṣaṇe ]
aorist: [1.] akṣata -- [5.] kṣaṇiṣṭhās akṣaṇīt 
[future: kṣaṇiṣyati kṣaṇiṣyate kṣaṇitā ]
verbal: kṣata V.+ kṣaṇítos 
[secondary: caṅkṣaṇ- cikṣaṇiṣa- kṣāṇaya- ]
derivatives: kṣaṇana kṣati E.+

√kṣap 'be abstinent'
present: [1.] kṣapati E.+ kṣápate 
verbal: kṣapitum 
derivatives: kṣapaṇa E.+ 
The words kṣáp V., kṣapā́ V.+ do not appear to be connected with this root.

√kṣam 'endure'
present: [1.] kṣámate etc. V.+ kṣámati etc. E.+ kṣā́mat -- [4.] kṣamyate etc. E.+ kṣāmyati 
perfect: cakṣame etc. B.+ cakṣamīthās 
[aorist: akṣamat acikṣamat akṣaṃsta akṣamiṣṭa ]
future: [1.] kṣaṃsyati etc. kṣamiṣyati B.+ -- [2.] kṣaṃtā kṣamitā 
verbal: kṣāṃta E.+ kṣamita kṣaṃtum E.+ 
secondary: passive: kṣamyate E.+ -- intensive: caṅkṣam- -- desiderative: cikṣaṃsa- cikṣamiṣa- -- causative: kṣamayati etc. E.+ kṣāmaye kṣamāpaya- 
derivatives: kṣám kṣā́ kṣamá AV.+ kṣamā E.+ kṣamaṇīya E. kṣaṃtavya E.+ kṣamitavya E. kṣaṃtṛ E. kṣāmya E. kṣā́man V. kṣā́mi SV. kṣāṃti E.+ kṣmā́ V.+ cākṣmá? RV. kṣamāpaṇa C1.

√kṣar 'flow'
present: [1.] kṣárati etc. V.+ kṣárate etc. 
perfect: cakṣāra 
aorist: ákṣār (3s.) 
[future: kṣariṣyati kṣaritā ]
verbal: kṣarita kṣáradhyai 
secondary: intensive: cākṣar- -- desiderative: cikṣariṣa- -- causative: kṣārayati etc. B.+ 
derivatives: kṣara V.+ kṣaraṇa C. kṣāraṇa C. kṣīrá? V.+

√kṣal 'wash'
secondary: causative: kṣālayati etc. B.+ kṣālāpayīta 
derivatives: kṣāla E.+ -kṣālaka E.+ -kṣālya C. -kṣālana S.+ 
Doubtless the same with the preceding root.

√kṣā 'burn'
present: [4.] kṣā́yati etc. 
verbal: kṣāṇa? 
secondary: causative: kṣāpáyati etc. 
derivatives: -kṣā́ṇa kṣātí RV. kṣāma B.+ kṣāra E.+
